claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR

Import origin cannot be determined from visual inspection of the engine blocks.
Functional and mechanical health cannot be assessed from static photos.
Usage history is not visible on the external components of the engine.
The witness report does not mention the state of factory seals or bolt markings.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine model code (2ZR) stamped on the block.
Close-up photos of the factory seals on the cylinder head and oil pan.
Video of the engine being hand-cranked or running to verify it is not seized.
Clear photos of the gearbox identification plate.
response.reason: The witness could not confirm the specific model or brand of the engines. Without proof of the 2ZR engine code, it is impossible to distinguish these from lower-value units.
